question: Who was the first ruler of the Sayyid Dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khizr Khan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first ruler of the **Sayyid Dynasty** was **Khizr Khan.**
 
• Khizr Khan was the **governor of Multan** under the **Tughlaq dynasty** before he **declared independence **and established the **Sayyid Dynasty in 1414 AD.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alauddin Alam Shah** was the l**ast ruler of the Sayyid Dynasty** and was succeeded by the Lodi Dynasty.
 
• **Muhammad Shah and Mubarak Khan** were **not** rulers of the Sayyid Dynasty.
 
• The Sayyid Dynasty ruled over the** Delhi Sultanate for around 37 years** and was succeeded by the Lodi Dynasty.
